{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Emerald green sheath dress, A-line silhouette reaching midi length, rich emerald (Hex: #046307), velvet.
Black pointed-toe pumps, sleek stiletto heel height moderate, glossy black (Hex: #000000), patent leather.
Silver drop earrings, classic teardrop shape hanging from lobe, bright silver (Hex: #C0C0C0), sterling silver.

This outfit works because the velvet dress provides a festive texture suitable for an upscale New Year's celebration while maintaining an elegant yet accessible feel within the everyday formality band. The emerald green color stands out beautifully against typical winter decor in an upscale restaurant, creating a striking visual impact under artificial evening lighting. Black pumps and silver jewelry complete the look with sophisticated touches that respect the refusal to dress too formally, keeping the ensemble chic but grounded."}
